messages:
emma: Quick thread  new marketplace private offer with an OEM reseller and two SIs. Need final pricing lanes, SI co-funding for training, and joint announce timing. Prefer short notes.

pavel: OEM asks for a reseller price that preserves channel margin. Can we carve a reseller SKU with a 10% reseller allowance on top of our committed tiers?

jasmin: We can but ops will want a separate SKU. Proposal: RSL-HW-BUNDLE-SKU mapped to same tiers but labeled reseller. Reseller allowance shown in the PO PDF, not marketplace listing.

diego: SI ask: they'd co-fund partner enablement workshops. Suggest we match up to $20k per quarter in co-funding, but credits only usable against field services invoices. Cap per SI: $25k first year. Legal ok?

pavel: Finance needs liability cap language. Also prefer co-fund as reimbursement vs invoice credit to avoid ledger complexity. Ops: can we do reimbursement flows?

jasmin: Ops: reimbursement doable but needs receipts and 30-day SLA to process. Marketplace private offers stay as invoice credits to the buyer; reimbursements handled off-list via partner ops.

emma: Timeline: pilot start 2024-10-01, OEM resell enabled 2024-11-01, public marketplace listing 2024-12-01. Marketing asks for co-announce copy 10 biz days before listing.

diego: Renewal protection ask from OEM: if customer increases usage, OEM wants uplift protection (cap reseller discount change to +/-3% at renewal). Legal: is that ok?

jasmin: Legal flagged complexity but will draft an uplift clause: 'reseller uplift collar +/-3% applied at renewal quote only'. We'll attach to PO PDF.

pavel: Also propose an escrow for unused onboarding credits: credits not used within 9 months move to an internal escrow balance that can be applied at renewal only with customer consent. Prevents surprise liabilities.

partner-bot: ticket_created: "OEM Reseller SKU + SI Co-fund Process" Ticket #99821. Assignees: jasmin, diego. Due: 2024-09-20.

emma: Action items:
- jasmin: open SKU creation request & ops mapping by 2024-09-10
- diego: draft partner co-fund terms + reimbursement flow by 2024-09-08
- pavel: draft finance guardrails + escrow accounting note by 2024-09-09
- marketing: co-announce copy and localization checklist by 2024-11-18

emma: Cool. I'll assemble PO PDF stub and share. Thanks all :raised_hands:
